avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces vandetanib plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concomitant use; consider alternative herbal products if mood support needed

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer significantly decreases vandetanib bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; consult oncologist for alternative antimicrobial if infection treatment required

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases vandetanib exposure and risk of toxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplement; use alternative antioxidant if desired

avoid_supplements.name: Kava kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hepatotoxicity risk; may impair vandetanib metabolism and increase liver toxicity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; counsel on hepatotoxic herbal alternatives to eliminate

caution_supplements.name: QT-prolonging supplements (hawthorn, digitalis)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Vandetanib carries QT prolongation risk; additive cardiac effects possible
caution_supplements.action: Monitor ECG; use lowest effective dose; baseline QTc assessment recommended

caution_supplements.name: Calcium and magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce vandetanib absorption if taken simultaneously
caution_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases vandetanib plasma concentration and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet during vandetanib therapy; educate on hidden sources

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase vandetanib absorption and peak concentrations
caution_foods.action: Administer vandetanib consistently with or without food; maintain consistency

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (if on concurrent medications)
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential interaction if using monoamine oxidase inhibitors; vandetanib alone has low risk
caution_foods.action: Standard dietary precautions; review with multidrug regimen

monitoring_notes: Monitor QTc interval at baseline and periodically; assess for diarrhea, rash, and hypertension as common vandetanib adverse effects. Screen for CYP3A4 inhibitor/inducer interactions as vandetanib is extensively metabolized through this pathway.
